ART THAT CARRIES ITS OWN PROOF
THE EXPERIMENT

What if the link
wasn't the artwork?

Most NFTs point somewhere else for their image. AFTERLIGHT keeps the image itself, its story, and its ownership together on Koinos.

This first edition is a testnet experiment. Testnets can reset; it is a demonstration of the design, not a permanence guarantee.

01

The image is the data.

Each compressed artwork is split into small pieces and written to the collection contract. No IPFS upload or external image host is required for the chain copy.

02

Put the pieces back together.

Read an artifact directly from the chain. This browser reconstructs the original file and checks its SHA-256 fingerprint.

03

Take the museum with you.

A small independent viewer reconstructs the artwork from a compatible node. Save a copy to recover the art without this website.
